sloka: केन ते नागनासोरु विक्षतं वै स्तनान्तरम् ।कः क्रीडति सरोषेण पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना ।। ५.३८.२६।।।।
transliteration: kena te nāganāsoru vikṣataṁ vai stanāntaram ।kaḥ krīḍati saroṣeṇa pañcavaktreṇa bhoginā ।। 5.38.26।।।।

translations.english: 'O Sita with a beautiful lap like an elephant trunk by whom is your bosom wounded? Who is sporting with an angry fivehooded snake?
